text:
maria: Heads-up — customer reported a big p99 jump ~1hr ago for hosted-api. Dashboard p99 went from ~180ms to ~1.2s but raw traces from the same time look normal. Can someone triage? :thinking:

maria: Quick context: customer is on Dedicated pool A, affected endpoint /v1/generate. Attached the panel screenshot in the ticket. Repro curl below if needed:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hello"}' -w '\nHTTP_CODE:%{http_code} TIME_TOTAL:%{time_total}'
```

jon: Looking now. Do we know if the dashboard p99 is coming from rollups or raw request metric?

maria: The dashboard uses metric name `api.request.latency_ms` (panel owned by platform-team). Not sure whether it's filtered for retries.

infra-bot: Notice: routing/ingress v2 was deployed at 1759431800 with config change `ingress.retry.enabled=true` for blue group.

jon: Ah. I see proxy logs from the same window with a lot of 502 -> retry cycles for certain customers. Those combined attempts will inflate aggregate latency if the rollup counts retries. :exclamation:

taylor: Confirming — our rollup job currently aggregates `latency_ms` across all attempts (no `attempt` tag filter). Traces (x-ray) only show the final successful span by default. So panel vs trace discrepancy is expected.

lucy: Quick check query you can run in clickhouse (example):
```sql
SELECT quantile(0.99)(latency_ms) AS p99, count()
FROM api_requests
WHERE day=toDate(now())
AND status='200'
AND attempt_index=0 
GROUP BY toStartOfMinute(ts)
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 20
```
This filters to the first attempt only.

jon: Ran a quick adhoc: when I filter attempt_index=0 p99 is ~190ms, when I remove the filter p99 jumps to ~1.1s for the same minute. So retries are inflating the rollup.

maria: Customer-facing impact: they saw their SLA alert for p99 and opened support ticket. We need an immediate mitigation and long-term fix for dashboards.

taylor: Immediate mitigation options: 1) disable ingress retries for the affected customer (scoped flag) 2) adjust dashboard to filter attempt_index=0 or status='200' 3) change rollup pipeline to dedupe attempts (harder).

jon: I can toggle the retry flag for that customer in feature-flags. Quick rollback to `ingress.retry.enabled=false` for group blue will stop new inflations. Anyone object?

maria: Do it. Also note the customer is on Dedicated pool A, make sure the change is scoped to their tenant. Add a note to the ticket.

jon: Rolling flag now -> `ffctl set ingress.retry.enabled blue false` -> applied. Monitoring now. :arrow_forward:

infra-bot: Feature flag change recorded: ffctl user=jon target=blue flag=ingress.retry.enabled old=true new=false at 1759432165

support-bot: Notifying customer: we applied a scoped config change to reduce retry amplification. Follow-up with steps and timeline. Ticket #SUP-8241 updated.

lucy: Also opened a tiny dashboard PR to add a checkbox filter for `attempt_index=0` and example query. Will request review from platform.

maria: Thanks. Long-term: we should decide whether rollups should exclude retries by default or add an explicit dimension. Filed infra issue #INF-312 to discuss the rollup model.

jon: Monitoring shows p99 returning to ~200ms after the flag change. I'll keep the flag off until we have the dash fix.

taylor: FYI: deploying a rollup pipeline change will take longer (schema + backfill). For now dashboards docs + patch + scoped flag is the correct safe path.

maria: Closing loop — customer notified, ticket updated, mitigation in place. We'll follow up in INF-312. Great triage team. :thumbsup:
